Help & tips

What this does

Shows whether enrolled local AI targets can complete real work across the worker, endpoint, model, and canary layers. Discovered endpoints remain neutral until you enrol them.

Enrol a target

Review a discovered endpoint and select the models you expect it to serve.
Choose a canary model, health cadence, routing roles, and fallback policy.
Validate every layer, then enrol the target.

Safe recovery

Run a manual check when current evidence needs refreshing.
Diagnose an incident before choosing a guided repair.
Automatic repair is opt-in and limited to named, supported service operations.

Pausing changes routing immediately

A paused or retired target stops receiving health checks and local routing work. Retiring keeps its historical incidents and impact records.
